description: A proxyfile: one gateway, the services behind it and the routes to them, from which proxyfile writes an Envoy configuration.

admin.description: The port of the admin listener, on 127.0.0.1; no admin listener when not written.

auth.description: The external check every request goes through before it reaches a service.

accept.description: The headers of the check's answer that reach the service; a name ending in * is a prefix.

ask.description: The service and the path the gateway asks.

enabled.description: true runs the check on every request it applies to, false on none.

only_with_header.description: The check runs only on requests that carry this header.

send.description: The request headers the check is sent; a name ending in * is a prefix.

timeout.description: How long the gateway waits for the answer.

when_unavailable.description: What happens to a request when the check cannot be asked: allow lets it through, deny refuses it.

limits.description: Limits on memory, connections and request headers.

connections.description: The most connections at once, from clients and to each service.

heap.description: The heap budget: the gateway shrinks its heap at 90% of it and refuses new requests at 98%.

request_headers.description: The largest header block and the most header fields a request may carry.

count.description: The most header fields in a request.

size.description: The largest header block of a request.

listen.description: The port of the public listener, on 0.0.0.0.

log.description: Which requests the request log writes.

sample.description: The share of the other requests that is logged.

status_from.description: The lowest status that is always logged.

namespace.description: The namespace of the gateway's own metadata, which the routes and the request log use; proxyfile when not written.

origins.description: The origins file, relative to this file: the CORS settings and, for each environment, its hosts and the browser origins it admits.

remove_from_clients.description: Headers removed from every client request before routing and before any filter; a name ending in * is a prefix.

routes.description: The routes, tried in the order written; the rpc entry marks where the RPC routes go.

oneOf.description: The place in the order where the RPC routes go.

rpc.description: The RPC routes: one exact-path route for each RPC method.

retries.description: How many times an RPC call that never reached its service is tried again.

oneOf.description: The service the methods go to.
The service the methods go to, and the name of their routes.

name.description: The name of the routes; the service's name followed by -rpc when not written.

service.description: The service the methods go to.

to.description: The service the RPC methods of each package go to.

oneOf.description: A route: a name, what it matches and the service it goes to.

auth.description: off sends the route's requests to the service without the check.

method.description: Matches only requests with this HTTP method.

pattern.description: Matches paths by this regular expression, in RE2 syntax.

prefix.description: Matches paths that start with this text.

retries.description: How many times a request that never reached the service is tried again.

rewrite.description: Replaces the matched prefix or path before the request goes to the service.

to.description: The service the route goes to.

additionalProperties.description: One service: a port per protocol, an optional Host header and an optional address.

address.description: The service's IP address; 127.0.0.1 when not written.

host_header.description: The Host header a request carries when a route sends it to this service.

services.description: The services behind the gateway, on the same host, by name.

timeouts.description: How long a request, an idle request and an idle connection to a service may last.

idle.description: The longest a request may go without sending or receiving data.

request.description: The longest a whole request may take.

upstream_idle.description: The longest a connection to a service is kept open with no request on it.

title: proxyfile
